figurative_meaning_en: One who seizes others' property, a robber or extortionist
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা হাঙর, সবসময় অন্যের জিনিস কেড়ে নেয়।
বাজারে এই দোকানদারকে হাঙর বলে সবাই জানে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a shark, always snatching others' things.
Everyone in the market knows this shopkeeper as a shark.
note: Refers to the predatory nature of a shark, metaphorically applied to greedy individuals in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
